<function name="GetFloatValue" parent="DNumberScratch" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Returns the real value of the <page>DNumberScratch</page> as a number.

See also <page>DNumberScratch:GetTextValue</page> and <page>DNumberScratch:GetFraction</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The real value of the <page>DNumberScratch</page></ret>
	</rets>
</function>
